options.name: arbiter_at_index
options.description: Identifies the position of the member in the array that is an arbiter.

options.name: atlas_auth
options.description: Authentication path intended for MongoDB Atlas Instances

options.name: auth_mechanism
options.description: Authentication type.

options.name: chaining_allowed
options.description: When I(settings.chaining_allowed=true), the replicaset allows secondary members to replicate from other secondary members. When I(settings.chaining_allowed=false), secondaries can replicate only from the primary.

options.name: cluster_cmd
options.description: Command the module should use to obtain information about the MongoDB node we are connecting to.

options.name: connection_options
options.description: Additional connection options. Supply as a list of dicts or strings containing key value pairs seperated with '='.

options.name: debug
options.description: Add additonal info for debug.

options.name: election_timeout_millis
options.description: The time limit in milliseconds for detecting when a replicaset's primary is unreachable.

options.name: force
options.description: Only relevant when reconfigure = true. Specify true to force the available replica set members to accept the new configuration. Force reconfiguration can result in unexpected or undesired behavior, including rollback of "majority" committed writes.

options.name: heartbeat_timeout_secs
options.description: Number of seconds that the replicaset members wait for a successful heartbeat from each other. If a member does not respond in time, other members mark the delinquent member as inaccessible. The setting only applies when using I(protocol_version=0). When using I(protocol_version=1) the relevant setting is I(settings.election_timeout_millis).

options.name: login_database
options.description: The database where login credentials are stored.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host running MongoDB instance to login to.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate with. Required when I(login_user) is specified.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The MongoDB server port to login to.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The MongoDB user to login with. Required when I(login_password) is specified.

options.name: max_time_ms
options.description: Specifies a cumulative time limit in milliseconds for processing the replicaset reconfiguration.

options.name: members
options.description: Yaml list consisting of the replicaset members. Csv string will also be accepted i.e. mongodb1:27017,mongodb2:27017,mongodb3:27017. A dictionary can also be used to specify advanced replicaset member options. If a port number is not provided then 27017 is assumed.

options.name: protocol_version
options.description: Version of the replicaset election protocol.

options.name: ssl
